methods.body: const ship=this.game.world.ship;let best=null,top=255;for(const id of this.game.world.men){const man=this.game.thing(id);if(man==null||man.state!="taken"||Math.floor(man.y)>top)continue;top=Math.floor(man.y);best=man}if(best==null){this.game.scroll=this.game.wrapX(this.game.scroll+1024);return}ship.speed=ship.speed-this.game.pilot.pace(ship);ship.climb=0;ship.y=Math.max(49,Math.min(104,byte(top-this.game.chance.last%8-20)))+ship.y%1;ship.x=(ship.facing>0?64:224)+ship.x%2;this.game.scroll=this.game.wrapX(best.x-(ship.facing>0?136:168))

methods.body: const first=Math.max(0,Math.floor(px/2)),last=Math.min(Math.floor(px/2)+wide,160);for(const trail of this.world.trails){if(trail.id<py||trail.id>=py+high)continue;for(let pair=first;pair<last;pair++){trail.inks[2*pair]=0;trail.inks[2*pair+1]=0}}if(!this.frozen)return;for(const star of this.world.stars)if(star.py>=py&&star.py<py+high&&star.px>=2*first&&star.px<2*last)star.lit=false;if(!this.planetGone||!this.groundShown)return;const holes=this.world.holes??[];for(let row=py;row<py+high;row++){let line=holes.find(h=>h.id==row);if(line==null){line={id:row,pairs:[]};holes.push(line)}for(let pair=first;pair<last;pair++)if(!line.pairs.includes(pair))line.pairs.push(pair)}this.world.holes=holes

methods.body: if(lit.length==0)return[];const at=(x,y)=>`${x},${y}`;const on=new Set(lit.map(p=>at(p[1],p[2])));const marks=new Map;const mark=(x,y,upright)=>{if(!on.has(at(x,y)))return;const m=marks.get(at(x,y))??[x,y,0,0];m[upright?2:3]=1;marks.set(at(x,y),m)};const xs=lit.map(p=>p[1]),ys=lit.map(p=>p[2]);const x0=Math.min(...xs),x1=Math.max(...xs),y0=Math.min(...ys),y1=Math.max(...ys);for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x++)for(let y=y0;y<=y1;y++){if(!on.has(at(x,y)))continue;if(!on.has(at(x,y-1))){mark(x,y,true);mark(x,y+1,true)}if(!on.has(at(x,y+1))){mark(x,y,true);mark(x,y-1,true)}if(!on.has(at(x-1,y))){mark(x,y,false);mark(x+1,y,false)}if(!on.has(at(x+1,y))){mark(x,y,false);mark(x-1,y,false)}}return[...marks.values()]

methods.body: const s=this.size,g=this.gap,m=this.margin;const left=this.root.safeLeft,right=this.root.width-this.root.safeRight,bottom=this.root.height-this.root.safeBottom;const out=[];const one=(id,label,icon,x,y,w,h)=>out.push({id,label,icon,x:Math.round(x),y:Math.round(y),w,h,faint:this.fit=="over"&&id!="start"});if(this.startShown){const sw=Math.round(2.4*s),sh=Math.round(.75*s);if(this.fit=="beside")one("start","START","",(left+this.fieldX-sw)/2,bottom-m-sh,sw,sh);else if(this.fieldY+this.fieldH+m+sh+m<=bottom)one("start","START","",this.middle-sw/2,this.fieldY+this.fieldH+m,sw,sh);else if(this.startOverLeft){const nw=Math.round(Math.max(1.5*s,Math.min(sw,this.fieldX-left-2*m)));one("start","START","",Math.max(left+m/2,(left+this.fieldX-nw)/2),bottom-m-sh,nw,sh)}else one("start","START","",this.middle-sw/2,bottom-m-sh,sw,sh);return out}const lw=this.extent("left","col"),lh=this.extent("left","row");const rw=this.extent("right","col"),rh=this.extent("right","row");const cw=this.extent("center","col"),ch=this.extent("center","row");const put=(side,x0,y0)=>{for(const k of this.keys.filter(k2=>k2.side==side))one(k.id,k.label,k.icon??"",x0+k.col*(s+g),y0+k.row*(s+g),s,s)};if(this.fit=="beside"){const lmid=(left+this.fieldX)/2,rmid=(this.fieldX+this.fieldW+right)/2;put("left",lmid-lw/2,bottom-m-lh);put("right",rmid-rw/2,bottom-m-rh);put("center",rmid-cw/2,bottom-m-rh-g-ch)}else{put("left",left+m,bottom-m-lh);put("right",right-m-rw,bottom-m-rh);put("center",(left+right-cw)/2,bottom-m-ch-(this.centerRaised?Math.max(lh,rh)+g:0))}return out

methods.body: const axis=this.axis;const size=axis=="x"?"width":"height";const kids=this.laid();const flexing=c=>c.flexes===true;let each=0;let flexN=0;for(const c of kids)if(c.visible&&flexing(c))flexN=flexN+1;if(flexN>0){let content=0;let visN=0;for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;visN=visN+1;if(!flexing(c))content=content+c.footprint()[size]}const extent=this.contentExtent(size);each=Math.max(0,(extent-content-this.spacing*Math.max(0,visN-1))/flexN)}const al=this.align;const cross=axis=="x"?"y":"x";const crossSize=axis=="x"?"height":"width";const crossOf=c=>{if(flexing(c))return{lead:0,extent:c[crossSize]};const fc=c.footprint();return{lead:axis=="x"?fc.y:fc.x,extent:fc[crossSize]}};let line=0;let lineBase=0;if(al!="none"){if(al=="baseline"&&axis!="x")this.refuseStackBaseline();for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;line=Math.max(line,crossOf(c).extent);const b=c.baseline;if(al=="baseline"&&typeof b=="number")lineBase=Math.max(lineBase,b)}if(al=="center"||al=="end")line=Math.max(line,this.viewExtent(crossSize))}let pos=0;return kids.map(c=>{const flex=c.visible&&flexing(c);const f=flex?null:c.footprint();const lead=f==null?0:axis=="x"?f.x:f.y;const box=axis=="x"?{x:pos-lead}:{y:pos-lead};if(flex)box[axis=="x"?"w":"h"]=each;if(al!="none"){const co=crossOf(c);const leadC=co.lead;let off=0;if(al=="center")off=(line-co.extent)/2;else if(al=="end")off=line-co.extent;else if(al=="baseline"&&axis=="x"){const b=c.baseline;if(typeof b=="number")off=lineBase-b;else if(c.visible)this.refuseBaseline(c)}box[cross]=off-(al=="baseline"?0:leadC)}if(c.visible)pos=pos+(flex?each:f[size])+this.spacing;return box})
